statement: A sensor records a signed change in room noise each minute. For each request, calculate the sum over the inclusive interval of minute markers. Readings can be negative because the room may become quieter. Many independent requests are supplied, so walking through every selected reading for every request is too slow. title: Longest Stable Battery Run
statement: A battery monitor records nonnegative energy usage for consecutive minutes. A valid run is a contiguous segment whose total usage is at most a supplied budget. Find the maximum length of any valid run. Usage values are never negative, so extending a run cannot reduce its total; this property allows a moving left boundary. If no positive-length segment fits, print zero. The run must consist of consecutive readings, and only its length is required, not its endpoints. The sequence may be very long, making checking all possible segments impractical.
input_format: n budget; next line n nonnegative integers

d=list(map(int,sys.stdin.buffer.read().split())); n,b=d[:2]; a=d[2:2+n]; l=s=ans=0
